differences.native: MySQL uses REGEXP_LIKE with an anchored, case-sensitive regular expression for the prefix alphabet and exact @leetcode.com suffix.
differences.app: SQLite combines GLOB for the leading letter and exact suffix with a second GLOB exclusion over the local part's permitted characters.
differences.rationale: The bundled SQLite runtime has no REGEXP_LIKE operator. Both predicates accept exactly the same address language while preserving the same one-table filter and projections.
